contract: Central PMS terminal cash-payment fiscal issuance command/readback

errorOutcomes.400: missing request body, missing required headers, invalid terminal cash tender ID, missing idempotency key, missing correlation ID, or request-level deterministic rejection
errorOutcomes.409: terminal cash payment not confirmed, payment confirmation missing, POS Server binding missing, semantic conflict, or idempotency conflict
errorOutcomes.5xxOrTransportFailure: unavailable or uncertain outcome; APT must read back before retry

errorOutcomes.404: TERMINAL_CASH_FISCAL_ISSUANCE_NOT_FOUND when no fiscal issuance has been prepared for the terminal cash tender
errorOutcomes.409: semantic conflict if returned by Central PMS gateway

authorityBoundary: APT persists terminal-local fiscal command evidence and calls Central PMS only. Central PMS owns fiscal workflow orchestration. POS Server remains authoritative for fiscal document creation and numbering. APT must not call POS Server directly, render independent fiscal truth, issue exit authorization, or command gates.
